page.notes: The small » marks in the left margin beside lines 1–10 and 14–25 are typographic line marks, not printed text, so they are left out. Doubtful readings: "autē" (line 14) and "mēte" (line 18) and "apprehēdi" (line 25) have a macron-like sign that may be a tilde; the marks are as seen. The page number is a decorative figure; read as 50. The catchword "& auxi-" is the start of the next page's first word, hyphenated at the foot.
